question: An infinite line charge with uniform linear density $+λ$ is on the z-axis. Analyze the torque on a short electric dipole of moment $p$ placed at $(r, 0, 0)$ with its moment oriented parallel to the line charge (i.e., along the z-axis). Evaluate this torque. To create a torque of the same magnitude on this dipole using a uniform electric field $E_{uni}$, what must be the angle $θ$ between the dipole and $E_{uni}$, if the magnitude of $E_{uni}$ is set to $λ/(\pi\varepsilon_0 r)$?
